tips.text: Hit an enemy with a basic attack before you cast Snip Snip!. Each hit builds a stack, and every stack adds another snip.
Aim the center of Snip Snip! at the enemy champion, since the center deals true damage and applies A Thousand Cuts, which heals you.
Use Snip Snip! to finish low-health minions, since it kills them instantly when they are low.
Dash in with Skip 'n Slash, then attack right away. The first empowered hit refunds part of its cooldown, so you can dash again soon.
Use Hallowed Mist to dodge a big spell or a trade. Enemy champions outside the mist can't target you, and their projectiles are destroyed.
Stay inside Hallowed Mist to keep your protection. The mist follows you once when you leave, and after that it fades.
Fire Needlework at long range to start a fight. Recast it as long as the needles keep landing, since each recast sends more needles.
Needlework leaves enemies slowed. Use that to chase them down, or aim it through a group so A Thousand Cuts hits several of them.

combos.name: Mist follows your dash
combos.when: When you want to keep the Hallowed Mist on you while closing in or backing off, such as against ranged poke or a tower.
combos.text: Cast W, then dash out with E. The mist moves to where the dash ends, so you stay untargetable to enemies outside it without spending the recast.

tips.text: Attack before you cast Snip Snip! so your hits build stacks; each stack adds another snip.
Aim the center of Snip Snip! at the enemy, since the center turns some damage into true damage and applies A Thousand Cuts.
Dash in with Skip 'n Slash, then attack right away. The first empowered hit gives back part of its cooldown.
Use Hallowed Mist when monsters hit you. Their attacks from outside the mist do no damage to Gwen.
Step inside Hallowed Mist in a fight to dodge enemy champions' targeted attacks and spells. It follows you once if you leave, then fades.
Open with Needlework on a distant target so they are slowed, then recast it as they stay in range for more needles.
Needlework needles pass through units, so aim down a line with several enemies to hit them all and heal more.

combos.name: Dash, hit, snip
combos.when: When you want to burst a champion or a camp after building a few Snippy stacks.
combos.text: Dash in, then land one empowered attack to get part of the dash cooldown back and add a stack. Then cast the scissors so they snip once more.

tips.text: Use Hallowed Mist when Aatrox casts The Darkin Blade or Infernal Chains. He can't target you from outside it.
Aatrox's attacks are telegraphed, so dodge them. Sidestep The Darkin Blade, and run toward him or to the sides to leave Infernal Chains.
Attack minions and Aatrox to build Snip Snip! stacks before you cast it; a full set of snips hurts him far more.
Keep your distance when Aatrox uses World Ender. A takedown extends it.
Dash in with Skip 'n Slash, then attack right away. The first empowered attack refunds some of its cooldown.
Stay out of Briar's Head Rush range early. If she stuns you, you can't use your abilities.
Cast Hallowed Mist when Briar dives in. She can't hit you from outside it, so she has to enter the Mist to fight you.
Hit Briar with Snip Snip! while she charges Chilling Scream, since she can't move during the charge.
Stay away from walls when Briar charges Chilling Scream. A full charge knocks you into one and stuns you.
Stay out of Apprehend's range and angle. Being pulled next to Darius is how he wins the trade.
Use Hallowed Mist when Darius commits, since he cannot target you from outside it. His Noxian Guillotine is blocked too.
Poke Darius while Apprehend is on cooldown. Then he cannot pull you in.
Do not fight long trades. Hemorrhage stacks build, and Darius gets stronger the longer a fight goes on.
Use Skip 'n Slash to dodge out of Decimate's swing, then hit back when it ends.
Don't use Needlework slow or other crowd control on Fiora while Riposte is ready; she turns it into a stun on you.
Cast Hallowed Mist when Fiora dives; she can't target you from outside it, and your armor and magic resist rise.
Fiora wants to hit a Vital with Lunge, so watch where it is and step so she can't line it up.
Keep attacking so Snip Snip! has stacks, and fight Fiora while Riposte is on cooldown.
Use Skip 'n Slash to dodge back out after you trade, so Fiora can't finish her Vitals.
Use Hallowed Mist when Gangplank commits Parrrley or a keg. His shots are destroyed on the mist and he can't target you from outside it.
Stay out of Powder Keg blasts. They slow you and hit hard, so don't dash in with Skip 'n Slash next to kegs.
Gangplank cleanses with Remove Scurvy, so slow him with Needlework only when you can follow up, not as a blind opener.
Attack with Gwen's basic attacks first to build Snip Snip! stacks, then cut him once the stacks are up.
Hit Garen with Needlework to slow him, but expect Decisive Strike to remove the slow and let him run at you.
Step back from Garen's Judgment; it hurts most when only you are in range. Stay near minions.
Stay out of Garen's reach once he uses Decisive Strike; the silence can cut off Hallowed Mist, so keep your distance.
Use Hallowed Mist to dodge Demacian Justice when you are low; Garen can't target you from outside it.
Poke Garen from range with Snip Snip! after a few attacks; his regeneration only works when you stop hitting him.
Stay out of Jayce's cannon range and dodge Shock Blast; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion in its path.
Jump on Jayce early with Skip 'n Slash and attack him a few times so Snip Snip! hits harder.
Use Hallowed Mist when Jayce commits his burst; his Shock Blast and Thundering Blow can't target or reach you from outside.
Jayce's To the Skies! leaves you slowed, so make sure Hallowed Mist is up before he can leap on you.

comboRefs.note: Hallowed Mist stays on Gwen after her dash, shielding her from Jayce's ranged poke outside the zone.

tips.text: Cast Hallowed Mist when K'Sante's empowered Ntofo Strikes or Path Maker is coming; he cannot target you from outside the mist.
Attack him with your basic attacks before using Snip Snip!, so it snips more times and hits much harder.
Land Snip Snip! with the enemy in the center of the cone; that part deals true damage, which ignores his armor and magic resistance.
Use Skip 'n Slash to step out of the way of his stun, then hit him with your first empowered attack to get the cooldown back.
Walk to the side when he charges Path Maker, because it travels in a straight line he picked when he started.
Fight him in long trades; he is a tank, and your passive deals damage based on his health and heals you.
When he goes All Out, he loses lots of health and resistances. Hit him hard with all three Needlework casts and he can't escape.
Hit Malphite with a few attacks before using Snip Snip! so it has extra snips and hits harder.
Step out of Seismic Shard's path or keep your distance; getting slowed makes his engage easy.
Hold Hallowed Mist for Unstoppable Force; staying inside it when he lands means he can't target you from outside.
Skip 'n Slash gets you in and out of range; attack once after it to get some cooldown back.
Gwen's damage is mostly magic and partly true, so Malphite's armor does little against her; trade with her stacks and keep attacking.
Stay out of Mordekaiser's reach and keep your distance when Darkness Rise is active; fighting inside the aura costs you a lot.
Sidestep Death's Grasp; being pulled into him is how he starts his trades.
Use Hallowed Mist when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is coming or his burst starts; he cannot target you from outside it.
Use Needlework to poke him while he walks up, and slow him before he reaches you.
Skip 'n Slash in and out for quick trades; pick a moment when his Indestructible is on cooldown.
Get Attacks in before you cast Snip Snip!. Each hit adds a stack, so the spell snips more times.
Dash in with Skip 'n Slash and attack right away. The first hit refunds some of its cooldown and gives you range and attack speed.
Stay in Hallowed Mist to dodge his Electro Harpoon. Projectiles from outside the mist are destroyed.
Go all in when Rumble Overheats; he can't cast any spells for a few seconds.
Fight him away from the burning trail of The Equalizer. Stepping out of it fast saves a lot of damage and slow.
Use Needlework to chase when Rumble runs. Each recast needs a hit, so aim well.

comboRefs.note: Mist moving with her dash keeps Gwen untargetable to Rumble's Flamethrower and Harpoon while she closes in.

tips.text: Step out of Decimating Smash's line when Sion starts charging; a long charge stuns you for a long time.
Use Hallowed Mist when Sion charges at you; he can't target you from outside it.
Stay out of Roar of the Slayer; being slowed lets Sion land his big smash.
Trade with Skip 'n Slash and attacks; the dash lets you step out of his reach and the empowered hits refund its cooldown.
Needlework slows Sion and ends up hitting hard against his large health pool; recast it when he walks into the needles.
Walk at Teemo with Skip 'n Slash and attack right away; the first empowered hit gives back part of its cooldown.
Stay out of Teemo's range, since Toxic Shot punishes backing out after a hit. Commit only when ready to trade fully.
Use Hallowed Mist when Teemo fires Blinding Dart; his dart cannot reach you while you stand inside it.
Hit a few attacks to build Snippy before Snip Snip!, so it snips more times and heals you through A Thousand Cuts.
Watch for Noxious Trap in bushes and choke points; mushrooms are stealthed, and stepping on one slows you.
Use the long range of Needlework to hit Teemo when he is invisible in a bush and lining up a trap.
Get on top of Vayne. She is fragile, and Skip 'n Slash lets you close the gap quickly and hit her with a faster, longer-reaching attack.
Attack a few times first to build Snippy stacks before Snip Snip!, so it snips more times when it lands.
Cast Hallowed Mist when Vayne is about to hit you with Condemn. It destroys projectiles from enemies outside it.
Stay away from walls when Vayne has Condemn ready, or you will be stunned and take extra damage.
Use Needlework to leave Vayne slowed so she can't Tumble away easily, then recast it while you chase.
Hit Vayne three times in a row and she takes extra true damage from Silver Bolts. Swap in and out of trades instead of staying in long exchanges.

comboRefs.note: Mist follows the dash, so Gwen can close on Vayne while staying untargetable outside the mist.

tips.text: Use Hallowed Mist when Yone commits with Fate Sealed or a trade. You can't be targeted from outside the zone, and the mist only follows you once.
Build stacks by attacking minions and Yone, then hit him with the center of Snip Snip!
Stay out of Mortal Steel's line. Two hits give Yone a dash that knocks you up, so back away once he lands the first.
Fight Yone right after you use Skip 'n Slash. The attack speed and extra range win you the short trade, and your first hit refunds part of its cooldown.
Don't trade for long while Yone is in Soul Unbound. His damage is stored and then repeated as true damage when he snaps back, so back off or burst him first.
Walk out of Smoke Screen right away; the slow ends as soon as you leave the cloud.
Use Hallowed Mist when Graves lines up End of the Line or Collateral Damage; he cannot target you from outside it.
Hit Graves with Needlework to slow him, then recast it while he is stuck in range.
Fight Graves up close with Skip 'n Slash and Snip Snip!. His shotgun is weaker at long range, and his damage is mostly physical.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard. Dragon Strike knocks you up if you are in his path.
Use Hallowed Mist when Jarvan jumps in with Cataclysm; enemies outside it cannot target you. Fight inside it.
Jarvan's Golden Aegis slows you. Use Needlework to slow him back and keep him from catching you.
Attack him before using Snip Snip! to build stacks, since each stack adds a snip.
Dodge Blade's Reach when Kayn swings it. Without a hit, he cannot use Umbral Trespass on you from long range.
Save Hallowed Mist for when Kayn dives in with Umbral Trespass, and stay inside it. He cannot target you from outside the Mist.
Slow Kayn with Needlework as he runs through walls, then hit him again to shorten Shadow Step and keep him from escaping.
Watch for the warning marker on nearby walls. It shows Kayn is close and can come out of the terrain beside you.
Stay near your minions or allies so Kha'Zix can't get the Isolated bonus damage from Taste Their Fear.
Use Hallowed Mist when Kha'Zix jumps in; he can't target you from outside it, so his burst is wasted.
Attack while Kha'Zix is out of cooldowns. He is weak without Leap, so that is the time to fight him.
Slow Kha'Zix with Needlework when he tries to run, then recast it to finish him off.
Dodge Kindred's Mounting Dread; the slow and Wolf's pounce after three attacks are how she catches you.
Cast Hallowed Mist when Kindred dives you; she can't target you from outside it, so her attacks are wasted.
Hit Kindred with Needlework to keep her slowed and recast it; this makes it hard for her to kite.
Don't try to finish a fight inside Lamb's Respite; no one can die there until it ends.
Attack Kindred first with Skip 'n Slash, then fight; Kindred is fragile, so pressure forces her to play safe.
Hallowed Mist makes you untargetable to Lee Sin when he is outside it. Cast it when he starts his dash with Resonating Strike.
Dodge Sonic Wave. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so stand behind a minion to avoid it.
Save Hallowed Mist for the moment Lee Sin starts Dragon's Rage. If you are untargetable, the kick will not land.
Fight him with Skip 'n Slash and attacks, then finish the trade with Snip Snip! once you have stacks built up.
Keep Hallowed Mist for when Master Yi jumps on you; he can't target you from outside it, so Alpha Strike fails.
Use Needlework to slow Master Yi before he turns on Highlander; after that he ignores slows.
Hit Master Yi with a few attacks while he heals with Meditate, so he spends mana to keep up.
Fight him after Skip 'n Slash, when you have the extra attack speed and range to hit him as he closes in.
Cast Hallowed Mist when Naafiri channels Hounds' Pursuit, so the hit lands on nothing and you take no burst.
Stay inside Hallowed Mist when Naafiri dives, since enemies outside it cannot target you. Their projectiles are destroyed on the way in.
Hit her packmates and her together with Snip Snip! in a fight; it hits everything in its cone, so aim it at the group.
Slow her with Needlework when she is running off after a trade, then recast to finish her.
Step into Hallowed Mist when Nocturne goes for Unspeakable Horror or Paranoia; he cannot target you from outside it.
Move out of Unspeakable Horror's range to break the tether before the fear lands.
Hold Skip 'n Slash to break away from Nocturne's tether.
Do not waste Needlework or Snip Snip! into Shroud of Darkness; wait for its short shield to fade.
Stay near your allies when Paranoia goes off; Nocturne can only dash to one target.
Land Needlework on Nocturne so he is slowed, then recast it to keep hitting him.
Stay away from Shyvana early. Much of her power comes from hitting things, so she is weak when you can keep your distance.
Step into Hallowed Mist when Shyvana dives. She cannot target you from outside it, and her Molten Burst is destroyed on the mist.
Hit Shyvana with Needlework as she comes in; it slows her, and you can recast it to hit her again.
Use Skip 'n Slash to dash away from Shyvana after a trade, or to close in and attack her first.
Stay inside Hallowed Mist when Skarner commits; he cannot target you there, and his Impale cannot grab you.
Do not fight near walls when Skarner charges at you; Ixtal's Impact stuns you if he pins you against one.
Use Needlework to slow Skarner as he closes in, then keep moving between recasts.
Skip 'n Slash away from Skarner when he comes for you; its dash is hard for him to track.
Use Hallowed Mist when Sylas goes for Abduct. His chains are destroyed against you outside the mist, so you can dodge his combo.
Stay in the mist and let Sylas waste his abilities, then fight him back once his cooldowns are down.
Sylas's health bar can mislead you. Kingslayer heals him when he is low, so don't chase a nearly dead Sylas without a finishing burst.
Fight Sylas when he has no Hijack to take your ultimate. Needlework can be stolen and used against you.
Attack Sylas to build Snip Snip! stacks before you cast it, so it hits hard when he comes in.
Use Hallowed Mist when Talon commits; he can't target you from outside it, so his burst gets wasted.
Stay in the mist. It follows you only once, so leaving it again lets Talon hit you.
Slow Talon with Needlework when he turns on you or tries to escape.
Fight Talon after Shadow Assault is spent; he has no easy escape then.
Keep attacking so Snip Snip! has stacks before Talon arrives; it hits harder with them.
Hold Hallowed Mist for when Viego dives you. Spectral Maw cannot hit you through it, and he cannot target you from outside.
Fight with Skip 'n Slash and keep attacking Viego. The attacks give you extra range and heal you when they hit champions.
Slow Viego with Needlework before he gets close. Aim to hit him with all the recasts, since you need to hit something to recast.
Do not walk through the Mist from Harrowed Path alone. Viego can hide in it and ambush you.
Stay healthy when your allies fall near Viego. He can possess a dead enemy and gain their abilities.
Use Hallowed Mist when Xin Zhao dives in. He can't target you with Audacious Charge from outside it.
Stay out of Wind Becomes Lightning's long thrust. It slows you and lets Xin Zhao charge from farther away.
Attack before you cast Snip Snip! so you have stacks and it snips more times.
Skip 'n Slash away after Xin Zhao's third Three Talon Strike hit lands, or stay out of his range so he can't finish it and knock you up.
Use Needlework to slow Xin Zhao when he runs at you. Keep your distance when he has Crescent Guard.
